bio: In the lavishly restored Château des Tesnières, South African chef Chantel Dartnall has brought to life an ambitious project combining fine dining and charming accommodation. The decor – a blend of Art Nouveau wood panelling and artwork from South Africa – makes for an eclectic atmosphere. With a focus on plants and flowers, the set menus are captivating with their visual poetry and the quality of the ingredients. The wine cellar, packed with wines from around the world, with a particular focus on South Africa, is impressive. A handful of luxurious rooms on the floor above.
